detailed_description:
LOW-ANGLE close-up on Zhou Yu: camera at chest height looking up, red lanterns and dark roof beams above his head, spotlight rim on his crown. Short assertive handheld push-in. On 火 his free left hand rises beside his shoulder and bursts open, fingers spread like a flame; on 光 he taps his own chest with his left thumb, proud and aggressive, eyes locked toward screen right where his opponent stands offscreen. No fan and no other person inside the frame.
Zhou Yu alone raps exactly <d>[Chinese] 赤壁这把火，是我点的光</d> following the rhythm, consonants, vowels and pauses of <Audio 1>. Start after the opening 0.25 seconds of silence. The other man keeps lips closed. Stop mouth articulation when the vocal ends; no invented syllables.
Main singer's face stays in a frontal or three-quarter view with unobstructed lips. Each microphone stays in the RIGHT hand just below the mouth, not across the lips. Zhuge Liang's LEFT hand holds the white feather fan, never in front of his mouth. Natural rapid rap articulation, head nods and shoulder drive on the beat, eyes locked on the opponent. Expressive but controlled arm gestures. Audience remains outside the battle circle. Keep both men distinct. No extra fingers, no changing props, no internal cuts, no written words or watermarks.
overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is the authoritative existing vocal performance and timing reference. Preserve it exactly; do not generate new lyrics, extra cheers, dialogue or repeated words.
